ownershipRules.laravel: Laravel owns website registrations, civil-registry projections, sponsorships, sponsors, documents and existing server integration tables.
ownershipRules.localServer: Local Server owns aid catalogs, local donor operations, suppliers, entitlements, disbursements, vouchers, local reports and operational audit.
ownershipRules.desktop: Desktop owns only device settings, protected sessions, caches, pending operations, checkpoints and conflict UI state.
ownershipRules.crossOwnerReferences: Cross-owner references store immutable identifiers only. No desktop or local table becomes the truth for a referenced Laravel field.
ownershipRules.snapshots: Names, identity numbers and contact values explicitly suffixed snapshot are immutable delivery/print evidence, not independently editable master data.
ownershipRules.localDatabaseAccess: Only ASP.NET Core Local API may open the shared SQLite operational database; desktop clients never share the SQLite file over the network.

rules: Use Schema::hasTable before touching a guarded table.
Use Schema::hasColumn for every guarded or source-ambiguous column.
Introspection may read information_schema metadata only; SELECT/EXPORT of business records is forbidden.
Missing metadata disables the dependent capability and emits a drift diagnostic; it never silently drops fields from the contract.

driftRegister.observation: The legacy column is singular update_at rather than updated_at.
